verdict.rationale: The pack does not document control-failure or drift alerts delivered to Slack, email, or ticketing tools, nor what context those alerts would carry. The 'custom triggers and actions' workflow blurb (drata-docs-3) never names notification channels or alert content, so it does not count toward this story. The email notifications on status.drata.com cover Drata's own service incidents, which is a different subject, and the monitoring training video and dashboard mentions describe in-app monitoring, not alert delivery.
